description: Mono compressor, 3HP, with a display reading out whichever control was last touched

params.text: Sets the level above which the compressor starts working, -93.6dB to 0dB
Sets how hard the signal is held down once it is over the threshold, from 1:1 for none to 20:1
Sets how fast the compressor clamps down once the signal crosses the threshold, 1ms to 100ms
Sets how long the compressor takes to let go once the signal drops back, 1ms to 300ms
Softens the corner at the threshold, spreading the change of ratio over 0dB to 24dB either side of it
Adds up to 60dB of gain after the compressor, to bring the level back up
Crossfades between the input and the compressed signal, from untouched at one end to fully compressed at the other
Delays the audio against the detector by 0 to 200% of the attack time, so the compressor is already clamping down when the transient arrives
Takes the compressor out of circuit, passing the input through untouched

inputs.text: The signal going into the compressor
Drives the detector in place of the input signal, which is how a compressor is made to duck for another part
